```plato
    // The face as it stands after the pass: rewritten if a flip claimed it,
    // unchanged otherwise.
    FlippedFaceAt(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, claims: Array<Integer>, face: Integer): TriangleFace
    {
        var e = self.FlipOfFace(topology, claims, face);
        return e < 0 ? self.Faces[face] : self.FlippedTriangle(topology, e, face);
    }
```
